reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept [FILE] STATUS [IS] data-name-1 with exactly one operand that may be qualified (VII.2.5.3 SR1) but not subscripted or reference-modified (§1985:III.2 Data-Name), refuse a missing or second operand, and update the item with the I-O status of every input-output statement on the file (GR1), including after a failed OPEN.

edition-consulted.switches: edition.SubscriptedClauseOperands (Year == 2002) admits an integer-literal subscript on data-name-1; false at 85, so the subscript is refused
keeps the written subscripts only when SubscriptedClauseOperands; empty at 85
occurrence screen asked only at 2002; returns at once at 85
the subject-to-OCCURS refusal is skipped only at 2002; asked at 85

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: COBOL-2002 alone admits a subscripted data-name-1 (kb/Work PB5602); 1985 and 2023 refuse it
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f17_01 exercises the plain FILE STATUS IS form; the omitted FILE word, qualification, the subscript/ref-mod/second-operand refusals and the status after a failed OPEN are not exercised

probes.printed: DECL 35 / OPEN-MISSING 35 ** / DECL 47 / READ-AFTER-FAILED-OPEN 47 / OPEN-OUT 00 / WRITE 00 / CLOSE 00 / READ3 00 WXYZ / EOF3 / READ3 10 (exit 0)
probes.expected: qualified S1 OF GRP updated (35 on OPEN of a missing file, 47 on the READ after it) and the same-named S1 OF OTHER-G untouched; STATUS S2 and FILE STATUS S3 without IS accepted and updated (GR1, GR2)

probes.printed: COBOL2024 FILE STATUS 'ST (1)' is written with a subscript; COBOL2024 'S2 (1:2)' is reference-modified; COBOL1970 'S4' is not a clause of the file control entry
probes.expected: all three refused: data-name-1 is one bare (qualifiable) data-name

reader.notes: 1985's glossary forbids a subscripted or reference-modified data-name in a general format unless the rules permit it, and VII.2.5.3 permits only qualification, so the 85 arm (shared with 2023) of the SubscriptedClauseOperands predicate is the right one. The status is maintained through a failed OPEN and the READ that follows.
reader.at-2023: fs2bad is refused the same way at --std 2023

refuter.evidence: fx1bad.cob (b,d): data-name-1 PIC 99 (category numeric), PIC X(3), PIC X with an 88, a File Section item and a file-name each refused (COBOL2455 x4, COBOL1639). fx3bad.cob (b): a Communication Section item refused COBOL2455. fx4m.cob (e): a Linkage Section data-name-1 (legal at 85) receives 35 from a failed OPEN in the called program. fx2.cob (e): indexed (STATUS without FILE, group of two X items) gets 22 on duplicate WRITE and 23 on a missing-key READ; relative gets 22 on duplicate WRITE and 42 on CLOSE of a closed file. Unsubscripted OCCURS-subject data-name-1 is refused at 85 by ScreenFileStatusItem, which matches 1985 (a table element reference must be subscripted outside four listed places, none a FILE STATUS clause). Diagnostic text naming 'local-storage' at 85 is cosmetic. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.5.3 SR2 (the text is in SR2); OK §1985:VII.2.5.4 GR1 (the text is in GR1); OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR4 (the text is in SR4).
